digest.component_or_area: plan review gate — det_floor module structure
propositions: det_floor.py at 793 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap by only 7 lines and must be split to restore headroom

the blocking-vs-never-blocking check distinction documented in det_floor's own docstring forms a call-graph seam: never-blocking checks (p2, p3, p6, p7) have zero inbound/outbound call edges to retained code

monkeypatch bindings in test_plan_review.py, test_af77_config_fault.py, and test_plan_review_prerequisites.py target DET_CHECKS, run_det_floor, and est_tokens — all in the retained half — so the split preserves testability without modifying test files

the moved cluster (det_advisory.py) must declare module-level imports for vague_hits_in_line, _lint_verify_command, and _verify_command_strings that p6_ac_quality calls as bare names, while det_floor.py drops those imports since p6 was their only consumer
det_floor.py stays the entry module and re-exports all moved checks so existing import points and attribute accesses resolve unchanged after the split
the split reduces det_floor.py to ~550 LOC (29% headroom) and produces det_advisory.py at ~300 LOC, both within the 200–500 target band
